name: Ca ta ma
summary: Cá tà ma, as Vietnam Airlines describes it, is a small soft fish from deep water at Lý Sơn and Bình Châu. The grilled plate comes with rice paper, herbs, and green chili salt.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the meat soft and fragrant.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: grill with salt and chili, fry, braise with turmeric, or cook a sour soup with lá giang. The grilled fish is eaten with rice paper, herbs, and green chili salt.
No street and no hour were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Deep water at Lý Sơn and Bình Châu, in Vietnam Airlines.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints from 250,000 VND a kilogram.
